hypothesis: One-pass, winner-only selection using currently observed identity without later lineage, legacy/prefix or request-ID regrouping may match local usage totals.
scope: Static local snapshot usage selection and per-request/model token vectors; both selections use the same original aborted-root exclusion solely to compare persisted usage. Lifecycle finalization and capability reduction are outside candidate projection; not a performance benchmark or product implementation.

candidate.stream: Use parser identityValue as observed at arrival; known unique Claude request ID may infer only subsequent missing IDs; never rekey earlier candidates.
candidate.publicStream: Same algorithm using parser.getIdentity() at arrival, including its provisional standalone inference; independent sensitivity variant.
candidate.common: One current winner per provider/session/response/subgroup; input+output maximum then later current ordinal; no loser retention, backward ID correction, final-session regrouping, mixed-legacy exclusion or copied-prefix exclusion. Candidate maps are separate from reference/audit raw DTOs.

control: Independent sorted maximum using final filtered DTOs and finalized grouping matches current winner IDs and canonical requests exactly; resulting per-request token vectors match frozen SQL facts.
